text.p: Fabrizio Ravanelli has said he wants a friendly between Liverpool and Juventus in memory of the victims of the Heysel stadium disaster if he completes a widely-expected move to the Merseyside club.
Ravanelli, who won the European Cup with Juve in 1996 before moving to Middlesbrough a year ago, is reportedly set to join Liverpool for around $12 million.
Middlesbrough were relegated from the English premier league last season and Ravanelli has made it clear he wants to leave.
The Turin daily La Stampa published an interview with the Italian forward on Monday in which he said he was ready to join Liverpool.
"It's what I want," he was quoted as saying. "And first of all I would ask for a friendly with Juve to be organised at Anfield."
"I'm a Juventus player and always will be. That's why I'd like to invite the parents of the Heysel victims."
Thirty-nine Juventus supporters were crushed to death under a collapsed Heysel stadium wall when Liverpool fans rioted before the 1985 European Cup final.
